title: The Name Wall
text: A wall covered in names, thousands of them, crossed out one by one in red. These were the faceless, the old folk say, before. Before they forgot. Near the bottom, written fresh, uncrossed, in your own handwriting, is a Scion's name.

options.label: The named Scion crosses out their own name, so the city takes them for one of its own.

outcomes.text: The city takes them in, and lets you all pass. They feel it take something with it.
Their face goes numb for a day, and their mouth will not shape words.

options.label: Scrub the name off the wall. It was not yours to write.

outcomes.text: It comes back, fainter, as you watch, in the same hand.

options.label: The wisest reads the other names, to learn who stood here before you.

outcomes.text: Some you know from the House's histories, and now you know how they ended.
